subject: Interim H400 allocation request + pro-rata credit / reservation hold
messages:
From: Tom Wallace <t.wallace@hyperbridge.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Li <sarah.li@hyperbridge.ai>, procurement@hyperbridge.ai
Date: Thu, 4 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary H400 allocation and pro-rata credit for reserved capacity

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the demo this week. We're ready to move forward with a 12-month Dedicated reservation (PO attached) but we've run into a short-term need: over the next 6 weeks our compute spikes require H400 capacity for inference testing. The committed reservation in the PO is H200-class; swapping to H400 across the whole reservation would materially change billing and we can't re-sign a new contract mid-quarter.

Can Redwood provide a temporary H400 allocation attached to our existing reservation for 6 weeks, with a pro-rata credit for the unused H200 capacity for that period? We'd also like a hold on the reservation (no auto-rebalance) while we finalize the amendment so our service doesn't get preempted.

Attached: Hyperbridge_PO_0418.pdf

Key asks:
- Interim H400 allocation (start 2026-06-07) for 6 weeks
- Pro-rata credit for unused H200 reservation during that window
- Reservation hold/no-auto-rebalance until amendment executed
- Temporary overage cap or capped uplift for burst pricing

Business note: we're onboarding two enterprise customers next quarter; delivering predictable capacity now affects renewal timing. Happy to jump on a quick call.

Thanks,
Tom Wallace
Head of Infrastructure, Hyperbridge AI
procurement@hyperbridge.ai
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Tom Wallace <t.wallace@hyperbridge.ai>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary H400 allocation and pro-rata credit for reserved capacity

Tom — appreciate the clear ask and the PO. I can escalate this for an executive exception (non-standard SKU allocation + pro-rata credit + reservation hold).

Quick questions to scope the approval:
- Expected H400 peak vCPU / GPU hours per week for the 6-week window (ballpark)
- Do you want the entire reservation swapped to H400 for that period or a partial burst pool?
- Any compliance/region constraints (we'll keep it in us-west for now)

Looping in Olga for deal-desk / exec approval. I attached the PO you sent for reference.

— Aditya
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Wallace <t.wallace@hyperbridge.ai>, Sarah Li <sarah.li@hyperbridge.ai>
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2026 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: temporary H400 allocation and pro-rata credit — escalation for exec exception

Team — escalating on behalf of Hyperbridge (HB). Summary and recommended guardrails below. Please review and sign off (Lauren + Karthik).

Customer summary: Hyperbridge has a signed PO for a 12-month H200 reservation (starts 2026-05-01). They need an interim H400 allocation for 6 weeks starting as early as 2026-06-07 to support an enterprise pilot. They request a pro-rata credit on the unused H200 portion for that 6-week window and a reservation hold (preventing automated redistributions) until an amendment is executed.

Proposed exception (recommended):
- Grant interim allocation: allow up to 100% of reservation capacity to be routed to H400 variants for a 6-week window, effective 2026-06-07 to 2026-07-19. This will be implemented via routing policy and temporary SKU mapping (no model code changes).
- Pro-rata credit: issue a one-time credit equal to the net difference between H200 vs H400 base reservation rate prorated over the 6-week period for the committed units that are inactive during the allocation.
- Overage and burst handling: set a temporary burst uplift of 1.25x for H400 overage rates, with a hard cap on billable overage of $50,000 for the window.
- Reservation hold: apply a reservation hold flag to prevent auto-rebalance/preemption until amendment is signed or 30 days, whichever comes first.
- Operational constraints: keep routing and allocations in us-west region only; limit API changes to routing policy (no infra changes).

Rationale: customer is mid-contract, strategic (enterprise pipeline), and the window is short. Upside: increases likelihood of renewal and expansion. Downside: temporary revenue delta and some complexity in billing accounting.

Attachments: term_sheet_hyperbridge_interim_h400.pdf (proposed amendment language and calculation worksheet).

Requested approvals / questions:
- Lauren: legal needs to confirm the amendment language and whether the reservation hold is acceptable operationally from a contract perspective.
- Karthik: confirm finance okay with the one-time credit and the $50k overage cap.

If you approve, I'll notify the customer and generate the DocuSign amendment. I recommend conditioning the exception on: (1) signed amendment within 10 business days, (2) one-month notice for early termination, and (3) the overage cap as proposed.

— Olga
Senior Deal Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Wallace <t.wallace@hyperbridge.ai>
Date: Mon, 8 Jun 2026 15:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: temporary H400 allocation and pro-rata credit — escalation for exec exception

Olga / team — reviewed. Approve the interim exception with the following binding conditions: 

1) Amendment execution: customer must sign the attached amendment via DocuSign before the interim H400 allocation goes live. DocuSign powerform: https://na1.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abcd-ef01-2345-6789

2) Credit cap: one-time pro-rata credit capped at $45,000. Finance (Karthik) please confirm recording and GL mapping.

3) Overage uplift: H400 burst/overage rate will be set to 1.25x the standard H400 rate for the interim window. Any additional discounts require separate approval.

4) Reservation hold: apply temporary hold for 30 days from approval start date or until amendment signature, whichever is sooner. No changes to hold beyond that without further exec sign-off.

5) Operational guardrails: allocation confined to us-west region; runtime team to implement routing policy and enable KV-cache migration notes in the term sheet.

Once Karthik confirms finance entries, Olga please send a formal confirmation to Hyperbridge and initiate the DocuSign flow. Include the term_sheet_hyperbridge_interim_h400.pdf in the envelope.

Lauren Bishop
VP, Legal & Commercials, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com
(attachments referenced: Hyperbridge_PO_0418.pdf, term_sheet_hyperbridge_interim_h400.pdf)
